benefits.desc: Access fitness centres across India through Cult.

modalDetails.fullDescription: All employees can access multiple Cult centres across the country through the Cult app to attain their wellness goals.
bulletPoints: Nationwide Cult membership access
Multiple fitness programs
Flexible workouts and training sessions

Team collaboration through fitness

benefits.title: Subsidized Healthy Lunch
benefits.desc: Nutritious meals subsidized by FYERS.

modalDetails.fullDescription: FYERS provides healthy meals Monday to Friday with a 50% subsidy to promote better nutrition and convenience. Meals are ordered via an app-based partner service that reduces food waste by allowing advance selection.
bulletPoints: 50% meal subsidy by FYERS
Veg and non-veg meal choices
Pre-order meals via partner app a day in advance
Available Monday to Friday
Remaining 50% adjusted in monthly payroll cycle

benefits.title: Doctor Consultation – Practo
benefits.desc: 24/7 access to verified doctors through Practo.

modalDetails.fullDescription: FYERS is tied up with Practo, a medical platform that connects employees and their families with verified doctors across all specialties for any health concern.
bulletPoints: Unlimited consultations per month per family
24+ specialties including psychological counselling and veterinary
Connect via audio, video, or chat
Connect with a doctor in less than 5 minutes — 24/7 availability
Complete family coverage — add up to 4 adults + 2 kids
Up to 20% discount on online medicine orders (prescription) and lab tests
Up to 10% discount on in-clinic appointments with Practo's cashless OPD network
Access to 1L+ doctor network pan India for offline appointment booking

benefits.title: Annual Health Camp
benefits.desc: Company organized preventive health check-up for all employees.

modalDetails.fullDescription: FYERS organizes an annual preventive health camp to promote early detection of health risks and overall wellbeing. The camp is typically conducted during the first quarter of the calendar year and is open to all permanent, probationary, and fixed-term employees across locations.
bulletPoints: Company-organized annual health camp for all members
Preventive screenings and diagnostics
Open to all employees — permanent, probationary, and fixed-term
₹2,000 reimbursement for members outside camp locations
Participation is voluntary; medical results remain strictly confidential
Health check results shall not be used for performance, promotion, or disciplinary decisions

Covers multiple aspects of physical health

mental.title: Mental Wellness
mental.subtitle: Prioritize your inner balance and emotional resilience.

benefits.title: Comprehensive Leave Program
benefits.desc: Flexible leave policies supporting work-life balance.

modalDetails.fullDescription: FYERS provides a comprehensive leave plan to help employees get ample time to rejuvenate and spend quality time with their loved ones. All leaves are accrued monthly and managed through Zoho People.
bulletPoints: Public Holidays - holidays declared by the central & state governments of India
15 days Privilege Leave (PL) annually — carry forward up to 30 days; excess mandatorily encashed
12 days Sick Leave (SL) — lapses at year end; no encashment on separation
Women's Wellness Leave — 1 day per month (12 days/year) for eligible women aged 18–52; auto-approved
Birthday Leave — 1 paid day to be availed within 1 week before/after birthday
Wedding Leave — 1 paid day to be availed within 1 week before/after marriage
Maternity Leave — up to 26 weeks (2 children) or 12 weeks (more than 2 children) with full pay
Paternity/Adoption Leave — up to 15 days within 6 months of parenthood
Bereavement Leave — up to 3 days per year for loss of immediate family member
Compensatory Off — for working on weekends/public holidays; must be availed within 90 days

benefits.title: Work From Home
benefits.desc: Flexible WFH benefit for eligible employees.

modalDetails.fullDescription: FYERS offers a Work From Home benefit to all permanent employees (excluding Customer Success, Sales, Quality, and Facilities teams) to promote flexibility and work-life balance.
bulletPoints: Up to 4 WFH days per month for eligible permanent employees
Not applicable to Customer Success (Support, Sales, Quality) and Facilities teams
WFH days cannot be carried forward, encashed, or transferred
All WFH requests must be submitted via the Zoho WFH Module with prior notice
WFH is not a replacement for leave — full productivity expected
Requests beyond 4 days require Department Head and HR approval

benefits.title: Mental Health Webinars
benefits.desc: Expert-led sessions on mental wellbeing.

modalDetails.fullDescription: FYERS provides access to multiple webinars by industry experts covering many aspects of mental health improvement.
bulletPoints: Mental health awareness sessions by industry experts
Stress management guidance
Available on ZOHO Connect

benefits.title: Grievance Helpline
benefits.desc: Around-the-clock emotional assistance.

modalDetails.fullDescription: FYERS has established a dedicated grievances email to ensure swift and transparent resolution of employee concerns. A structured escalation matrix is in place.
bulletPoints: Submit grievances to membergrievances@fyers.in
HR acknowledges within 48 working hours with a reference number
Structured 7-step resolution process
Escalation to HR Ops → Asha Murali → HR Head (Girish Subramanian)
No retaliation for raising grievances in good faith
All grievances handled with strict confidentiality

benefits.title: Mindfulness & Meditation
benefits.desc: Daily guided meditation and mindfulness practices.

modalDetails.fullDescription: Employees can benefit from daily guided meditation and mindfulness programs available as part of the FYERS wellness offering (Mind the Mind).
bulletPoints: Daily guided meditation
Mindfulness — Mind the Mind program
Stress reduction techniques

benefits.title: Milestone Celebrations & Team Events
benefits.desc: Events and activities celebrating milestones and building team spirit.

modalDetails.fullDescription: FYERS organizes multiple events celebrating milestones, team outings, dinners, lunches, and team-building activities to drive engagement and collaboration across teams.

Team-building activities

financial.title: Financial Wellness
financial.subtitle: Build security, stability, and long-term prosperity.

benefits.title: Insurance Benifits
benefits.desc: Health insurance coverage for employees and dependents.

modalDetails.fullDescription: The Group Health Insurance Program provides pre-defined insurance coverage to all employees and their dependents for hospitalization expenses due to illness, disease, or injury.
bulletPoints: ₹5,00,000 coverage per person
Covers employees and dependents
Hospitalization due to illness, disease, or injury
₹30,00,000 Group Personal Accident Insurance — covers accidental death, disability, or injury
Group Term Insurance — 3× base salary for career level 8 & below
Group Term Insurance — 5× base salary for career level 9 & above
Coverage subject to pre-defined underwriting criteria
Policy details at fyers.ethika.in/employee/home

benefits.title: Retirement Benifit
benefits.desc: Retirement savings and long-term financial stability.

modalDetails.fullDescription: FYERS contributes to statutory social security schemes under the Code on Social Security, 2020, including EPF, EPS, EDLI, and Gratuity.
bulletPoints: 12% employer EPF contribution on restricted PF wages
A portion allocated to Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS) as per law
EDLI — 0.50% employer contribution providing life insurance to EPF-covered employees
Gratuity eligibility after 5 years of continuous service (4 years 6 months deemed as 5 years)
Gratuity = 15/26 × Last Drawn Eligible Wages × Completed Years of Service
Statutory bonus administered per Code on Wages, 2019

benefits.title: ESI & Statutory Compliance
benefits.desc: Employee State Insurance and statutory social security benefits.

modalDetails.fullDescription: FYERS complies with the Code on Social Security, 2020 for Employee State Insurance (ESI) for all eligible employees, ensuring access to medical, sickness, maternity, and disablement benefits.
bulletPoints: Employer ESI contribution: 3.25% of applicable wages
Employee ESI contribution: 0.75% of applicable wages
Contributions remitted within statutory timelines
Eligible employees entitled to medical, sickness, maternity, and disablement benefits
Applicability determined based on wages as defined under Code on Wages, 2019

benefits.title: Employee Referral Program
benefits.desc: Earn rewards by referring great talent.

modalDetails.fullDescription: FYERS believes great talent knows great talent. Employees can refer candidates via ZOHO Recruit and earn referral bonuses paid in two installments.
bulletPoints: Non-technical roles: Up to ₹30,000 (₹15,000 below manager; ₹30,000 manager & above)
Technical roles: Up to ₹60,000 (₹30,000 below manager; ₹60,000 manager & above)
First 50% paid after referred recruit completes 3 months of probation
Final 50% paid after referred recruit completes 6 months of service
All referrals must be submitted via ZOHO Recruit → Referrals section only
Not applicable for freshers, intern conversions, or intercompany transfers

benefits.title: Creche Reimbursement
benefits.desc: Childcare expense support for working parents.

modalDetails.fullDescription: FYERS supports working parents by reimbursing creche expenses in accordance with the Code on Social Security, 2020, where a common creche facility is not provided.
bulletPoints: Up to ₹8,000 per month per child
Applicable for children up to 6 years of age
Employee may choose creche of their choice
Submit valid monthly bills and child's birth certificate
Claims submitted via ZOHO Expense tool

benefits.title: Training Reimbursement Program
benefits.desc: Reimbursement for external courses and conferences that benefit your work.

modalDetails.fullDescription: FYERS reimburses employees who undertake further studies, training courses, or conferences outside of work that benefit their role. Eligibility requires at least 6 months of service and high work performance.
bulletPoints: Minimum 6 months of service and demonstrated high performance required
Course or conference must be justified and approved by line manager and Department Head
Final approval at sole discretion of HR & Management
Submit approval email, fee receipts, and completion certificates via ZOHO Expense

Entire cost covered by the company
